title: FloodGuard Refund Interest Rates by Delay
content:
FloodGuard Private Flood Policy — rate of interest on refunds

Refund interest accrues at 6 percent a year when more than 30 days have passed from the cancellation date to the refund date; at 3 percent a year when more than 7 days but no more than 30 days have passed; and not at all otherwise.

The delay is counted in calendar days from the cancellation date of the policy — the date its coverage ended, as shown on the cancelled policy — to the date the refund is issued.

| Calendar days from cancellation date to refund date | Yearly rate of refund interest |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | none |
| more than 7, up to and including 30 | 3 percent |
| more than 30 | 6 percent |

Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical refund dates):

- 7 days after the cancellation date: no interest; 8 days after: 3 percent a year.
- 30 days after the cancellation date: 3 percent a year; 31 days after: 6 percent a year.
